subject: Creating a Shortcut for a Shiny App (LINUX)!

messages.author: 33899ed1aae53fa6
messages.subject: Creating a Shortcut for a Shiny App (LINUX)!
parts:
Dear,

Can I create a shortcut for a shiny application in linux? For the windows I have seen that it is possible!

Already, grateful!

messages.author: 33899ed1aae53fa6
messages.subject: Re: Creating a Shortcut for a Shiny App (LINUX)!
parts:
I've tried:

#!/bin/bash

#"/usr/lib/R/bin/exec/R" -e "shiny::runApp('./app',launch.browser=TRUE)"

Rscript --no-save --no-restore -e "library(exams); shiny::runApp('./app/', launch.browser=TRUE)"

or

R CMD BATCH "library(exams); shiny::runApp('./app/', launch.browser=TRUE)"

or

R -e "shiny::runApp('./app', launch.browser=TRUE)"

but none work with double-click. Any idea?

messages.author: a814dd0eade31e3e
messages.subject: Re: Creating a Shortcut for a Shiny App (LINUX)!
parts:
My guess is you need to change the file permission to make is executable. Not sure what you tried.

Take a look at this code https://github.com/vnijs/radiant/blob/master/R/radiant.R#L332-L358

It is a function to create a launcher icon on the users desktop on Linux. It does more than you wanted but it will be straightforward to simplify
launch_string

I know the script works but can't check if double-clicking works (linux box is at the office). However, I have a similar function for Windows and Mac and both work. Let me know if it works on Linux.

messages.author: 33899ed1aae53fa6
messages.subject: Re: Creating a Shortcut for a Shiny App (LINUX)!
parts:
Hi Vincent!

The problem was with my "nautilus". The option "dconf - org - gnome - nautilus - preferences - executable-text-activation", changing for "launch", solved my problem! Unfortunately, this is not trivial. Anyone who use the application on Linux, you can not just open the application with "chmod +x", if the above path does not agree.

Thank very much.
